name: Saleswise
tagline: AI workspace built for real estate agents.
description: Saleswise is an AI toolkit for real estate agents that generates client-ready comparative market analyses (CMAs), listing descriptions, emails, scripts, and social posts from real-estate-trained models. Its Studio tools add virtual staging, decluttering, and sky replacement for listing photos, plus a branded flyer maker. It's a single flat-rate subscription rather than a full CRM.
edge: Bundles CMA generation, photo staging, and 30+ agent-trained content tools into one $39/mo subscription built specifically for realtors.
